text: The admin at Cloud Kicks recently implemented Sales Cloud and needs to understand the adoption of Lightning Sales Console. What should a consultant recommend to analyze adoption?

options.text: Run the Salesforce Optimizer.
Open the Lightning Usage App.
Create a custom report.

explanation: The Lightning Usage App is the built-in adoption tool: it shows daily/monthly active users, page views, and usage by browser and page, including the Sales Console. Salesforce Optimizer reports on configuration health, not adoption, and a custom report can't see page-usage data.

text: Cloud Kicks recently purchased Salesforce, and the leadership team is excited about being able to forecast more accurately. Sales managers say that making updates to forecasted amounts during the pipeline meetings is time consuming, and it is difficult to review all of the committed opportunities within the meeting time. What should the consultant recommend to help make meetings more efficient while making real-time forecast updates?

options.text: Use in-line editing to update the forecast amount for records.
Modify multiple opportunities at one time in the Forecast page.
Tell reps to use the list view to move opportunities between stages.

explanation: Inline editing on the Forecasts page lets managers adjust forecast amounts directly during the pipeline review without opening each opportunity. Forecasts can't bulk-edit opportunities (Option B), and moving opportunities between stages in a list view (Option C) is a rep task that doesn't update forecast adjustments.

text: Cloud Kicks wants to enable Person Accounts. What does the consultant need to do before enabling Person Accounts?

options.text: Disable access to Experience Cloud sites during the cutover.
Set default sharing of Account to Public Read/Write.
Create at least one Account record type.

explanation: Person Accounts require at least one Account record type to exist before they can be enabled, because Salesforce creates a dedicated Person Account record type alongside the business Account type. No sharing change or Experience Cloud shutdown is required.

text: A consultant is meeting with a new client to design a rollout strategy for its Sales Cloud implementation. What should the consultant do during the planning stage to ensure a successful implementation?

options.text: Identify which Salesforce features and functions to use.
Design a prototype of the suggested solution.
Define goals, metrics, project schedule, and sales processes.

explanation: The planning stage is where the consultant defines success: goals, the metrics that will measure them, the project schedule, and the sales processes that will be implemented. Feature selection and prototyping come later, once requirements are known.

text: Each product engineer at Cloud Kicks supports a specific product line. There are five product lines. While sales reps sell all of the company's product lines, sales management wants the appropriate product engineer to be able to automatically view any new Opportunity for their particular product line with Read-Only rights. What should the consultant do to meet the requirement?

options.text: Enable Default Account Teams for each product line.
Enable Default Opportunity Teams for the Opportunity.
Create criteria-based opportunity sharing rules for each product line.

explanation: A criteria-based opportunity sharing rule (on the product-line field) automatically grants Read-Only access to the matching product engineer's group whenever a new opportunity is created. Account Teams don't target opportunities by product line, and default Opportunity Teams are set per owner, not per criteria.

text: Cloud Kicks is implementing Sales Territories for its retail sales unit. The sales director is requesting a detailed roll-up forecast for territories. What should the consultant recommend?

options.text: include the Forecast Manager field on the Account page layout.
Assign a Forecast Manager to each region.
Assign a role for each manager in the user role hierarchy.

explanation: Territory forecasts roll up through the territory hierarchy, and the roll-up is driven by the Forecast Manager assigned to each territory. The role hierarchy (Option C) drives role-based forecasts, not territory forecasts, and adding a field to a layout does nothing for roll-ups.

text: Cloud Kicks sales reps want to see all of the details on their current opportunities with a minimal amount of navigation or clicks to cycle through them. Which functionality should the consultant recommend?

options.text: Develop a new Sales Console app including opportunities.
Select the Split View option from the My Opportunities list view.
Create a dashboard with reports on My Opportunities.

explanation: Split View on a list view shows the list on the left and the selected record's full detail on the right, so reps can cycle through opportunities with a single click each. A console app or dashboard is far heavier for the same need.

text: In a recent management meeting, the VP of sales voiced concern over the current economic environment. To better understand the effectiveness of its marketing efforts, the VP expressed a need to monitor and reduce churn going forward. Which strategy should a consultant recommend to address the VP's concern?

options.text: Create a year over year sales by Account report.
Create an average stage duration by Opportunity report.
Create a Historical Trending report.

explanation: Historical Trending reports snapshot field values over time, so the VP can see how accounts and pipeline change and spot the drop-offs that signal churn. Year-over-year sales and stage-duration reports show revenue and velocity, not retention trends.

text: The Cloud Kicks pipeline and forecasting reports are inaccurate because sales reps are creating opportunities after they are already closed won. Sales management wants visibility into how often the sales reps are creating these types of opportunities. Which solution should the consultant recommend?

options.text: Run the Opportunity Pipeline standard report to view the upcoming opportunities by stage.
Configure a report that displays opportunities that have an earlier closed date than created date.
Implement automation to update the opportunity to the first stage in the sales process.

explanation: An opportunity report filtered for Close Date earlier than Created Date isolates exactly the opportunities that were entered after they were already won. The standard pipeline report won't surface them, and automation that resets the stage hides the problem instead of measuring it.

text: The VP of sales at Cloud Kicks wants to provide options to sales reps for changing account or contract details for a created order. Which condition should the consultant consider to meet this requirement?

options.text: The order must be associated with an active contract.
The order associated with the account is in draft status.
The currency associated with the order can be different from the contract.

explanation: An order's Account and Contract can only be changed while the order is in Draft status; once activated those fields are locked. Orders don't need an active contract (Option A), and the currency must match the contract's, not differ from it.

text: A consultant has successfully deployed Sales Cloud at Cloud Kicks. What is the final step in completing an engagement?

options.text: Activate users in the system.
Validate the implementation.
Obtain stakeholder sign-off.

explanation: An engagement closes with formal stakeholder sign-off confirming that deliverables meet the agreed scope. Validation and user activation happen before sign-off, not after.

text: At a kickoff meeting for a new project, a consultant starts gathering information to be used in the project implementation plan. They ask the participants to define what project success will look like. Which strategy is the consultant using?

options.text: Design Direction
Discovery
Challenge Framing

explanation: Asking participants to define what success looks like is Discovery: gathering the goals, pain points, and definitions of done that shape the plan. Challenge Framing and Design Direction are later steps that build on Discovery output.

text: A consultant is working with Cloud Kicks (CK) on its initial Sales Cloud implementation. CK wants its sales reps to be able to use Sales Cloud to track accounts, contacts, and opportunities before its global conference in 4 months. What should the consultant recommend to meet the requirement?

options.text: Set obtainable metrics, goals, and milestones before the conference.
Implement Sales Cloud out of the box and iterate before the conference.
Reduce the scope and deploy Accounts and Contacts before the conference.

explanation: With a fixed date four months out, the consultant should first set obtainable goals, metrics, and milestones so the scope fits the deadline and progress can be tracked. Deploying out of the box without goals or unilaterally cutting Opportunities both skip the alignment step.

text: The Cloud Kicks sales team travels frequently and often needs to convert leads while away from the home office. What should a consultant recommend?

options.text: Enable Conversions for the Salesforce mobile app in Lead Conversion settings.
Create a Global Action to convert leads via the Salesforce mobile app.
Install an AppExchange package to convert leads via the Salesforce mobile app.

explanation: Lead conversion in the Salesforce mobile app is controlled by the Enable Conversions for Salesforce Mobile setting under Lead Settings. Once enabled, reps convert leads natively on their phones — no Global Action or AppExchange package is needed.

text: Access to Opportunities at Cloud Kicks should be restricted. Sales users should only have access to two categories of Opportunities: * Opportunities they own * Opportunities that are tied to accounts they own Which action should a consultant take to meet the requirement?

options.text: Set organization-wide defaults for Accounts and Opportunities to Private.
Set organization-wide defaults for Accounts and Opportunities to Public Read-Only.
Set Opportunity access on the role to View All Opportunities associated with the owner's accounts.

explanation: With Opportunity OWD Private, the role setting View All Opportunities associated with the owner's accounts grants a user access to opportunities on accounts they own in addition to their own opportunities. Setting OWDs alone (Options A and B) can't express the account-ownership condition.

text: A sales rep at Cloud Kicks must have access to all child accounts of the accounts they own. The organization-wide default setting for Account is Private. What happens if a sales rep has access to a parent account?

options.text: Access to child account records is granted via the Account Hierarchy.
Access to child account records needs to be shared manually,
Access to child account records is controlled by default Account Teams.

explanation: The Account Hierarchy is only a display of Parent Account relationships; it doesn't grant record access. With a Private OWD, owning the parent gives no access to child accounts, so child records must be shared manually or via sharing rules/teams.

text: Annual sales numbers change depending on renewal periods and new products. Sales managers at Universal Containers (UC) want to emphasize the importance of customer retention when prioritizing the pipeline and customer engagement for the sales team. Which metric should the consultant recommend to help UC emphasize the importance of customer retention to the overall business strategy?

options.text: Annual Contract Value (ACV)
Total Pipeline Value
Customer Lifetime Value (CLV)

explanation: Customer Lifetime Value captures the total revenue expected over the life of the relationship, which directly ties retention to business value. ACV and pipeline value measure new/annual bookings and don't reward keeping customers.

text: Universal Containers has implemented a lead qualification process that uses a lead scoring formula. Upon review, many of the converted leads with the highest scores had little interest in making a purchase. Which modification to the current lead qualification process should a consultant recommend?

options.text: include a measure for the number of marketing touches.
Increase points for actions that indicate Intent.
Evaluate each record against the target marketing persona.

explanation: Leads that score high yet show little interest mean the model rewards passive attributes over behavior; increasing points for actions that indicate buying intent (demo requests, pricing views) makes the score reflect real interest. Counting marketing touches or persona fit doesn't measure intent.

text: Sales reps at Cloud Kicks (CK) need to see the Opportunity amount with the Account's discount field. CK sales reps are located in different regions and use different currencies. A consultant creates a custom formula field on the Opportunity. Which currency will the custom formula use for its value if the opportunity and account records have different currencies?

options.text: Opportunity currency
User currency
Corporate currency

explanation: A custom formula field on the Opportunity that references an Account currency field converts the referenced amount into the opportunity's currency, so the result is in the opportunity currency. User and corporate currency only affect how converted totals display in reports.

text: Cloud Kicks wants to help its sales reps identify stalled opportunities in a single view. Which solution should the consultant recommend to meet the requirement?

options.text: Create a Lightning Web Component.
Use Deal Insights in Pipeline Inspection
Create a screen flow.

explanation: Pipeline Inspection with Deal Insights highlights stalled and at-risk opportunities in a single pipeline view using Einstein signals such as inactivity and pushed close dates. A custom LWC or screen flow would have to be built and maintained for the same insight.

text: Cloud Kicks is implementing Sales Cloud and has asked a consultant to create an architecture diagram of the system. Which stage of the project lifecycle does this fall under?

options.text: Initiate
Plan
Execute

explanation: Producing the architecture diagram is part of the Plan stage, where the solution design is documented before build starts. Initiate defines the charter; Execute is where the design is implemented.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) has an external enterprise resource planning (ERP) system that stores product order information. CK wants to view those orders as a related list on the Account record in real time. Which best practice should the consultant recommend?

options.text: Create a Lightning component, Get the real-time product order information from the ERP system using a REST integration. Add the component to the account page.
Create a custom product order information object. Run a nightly batch job to get details from the ERP system. Add the custom object as a related list on the Account.
Implement Salesforce Connect and an external object to get real-time product order information. Add the external object as a related list on the Account.

explanation: Salesforce Connect exposes the ERP orders as an external object that behaves like a standard related list while the data stays in the ERP and is read in real time. A nightly batch (Option B) isn't real-time, and a custom REST component (Option A) is more code to build and maintain.

text: Cloud Kicks maintains products and price books on an external platform due to the high frequency of product pricing changes. Sales managers want to monitor pipeline by sales rep and track team revenue to goal in Sales Cloud. What should the consultant do to meet the requirement?

options.text: Implement Opportunity Teams and Opportunity Splits.
Create reports on closed Opportunities.
Use Opportunities and enable Forecasts.

explanation: Pipeline by rep and revenue to goal come from Opportunities with Collaborative Forecasts and quotas enabled; products and price books can stay external because forecasting works on opportunity amounts. Splits/teams and closed-opportunity reports don't give quota tracking.

text: The Sales Cloud implementation at Cloud Kicks (CK) is now live. End user training is complete. IT stakeholders have signed off on the technical aspects of the project. The CK admin continues to call the consultant with questions about the sales process. What should the consultant do?

options.text: Suggest that CK purchase a support agreement.
Recommend that the admin attend Salesforce instructor-led training.
Conduct a knowledge transfer with the admin.

explanation: Ongoing questions after go-live mean the admin didn't receive an adequate knowledge transfer; conducting one closes the gap and lets the admin own the solution. Selling a support agreement or sending the admin to a class doesn't transfer knowledge about this specific implementation.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) has organization-wide defaults set to Public Read-Only for Opportunity. One of the Account Team roles at CK is Executive Sponsor. Account Team members with the Executive Sponsor role need Read/Write access to all child Opportunities. How should the consultant meet the requirement?

options.text: Create an Account sharing rule to grant Read/Write access to Opportunities.
Create an Opportunity sharing rule to grant Read/Write access to Opportunities.
Create a flow to grant Read/Write access to Opportunities.

explanation: Read/Write access on opportunities is granted by an Opportunity sharing rule that targets the users who hold the Executive Sponsor role (for example via a public group), raising them above the org-wide Read-Only default. Account sharing rules grant account access, and a flow isn't a supported sharing mechanism.

text: Universal Containers continues to see substantial growth year-over-year. Outside sales reps think their territories are too dense to cover adequately. Leadership has decided to modify the existing sales territories and hire additional staff to make the account allocations more manageable. Some states will change from one territory to two or more smaller territories. in these instances, accounts will need to be reassigned to new territories. Sales operations wants to review the territory account assignments and verify the accuracy before the changes are reflected in Sales Cloud. How should the consultant show sales operations what the data will look like after the change?

options.text: Develop reports and dashboards that compare the existing and new territories.
Run the updated assignment rules in the Planning State and view the accounts on the territory detail page.
Install the Territory Health Assessment app from AppExchange.

explanation: A territory model in the Planning state lets sales operations run the updated assignment rules and inspect the resulting account assignments on each territory's detail page before activating the model, so nothing changes for users until the results are verified.

text: After Cloud Kicks implemented Sales Cloud Einstein, a consultant realizes they are unable to activate all of the features. Which step should the consultant take to troubleshoot the issue?

options.text: Confirm users have the feature license assigned.
Reconfigure the Einstein Lead Scoring app.
Check the Sales Insights Integration User profile configuration.

explanation: Sales Cloud Einstein features are gated by the Sales Cloud Einstein feature license; if users don't have it assigned, features can't be activated for them. Reconfiguring Lead Scoring or the integration user profile doesn't address missing licenses.

text: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) finished implementing Sales Cloud for a mid-market sales team. Sales management wants to track data completeness. Which common metric should the consultant recommend that NTO use to measure core Sales Cloud data?

options.text: Record Count
User Adoption
Field Usage

explanation: Field Usage — the percentage of key fields populated on core records — is the standard metric for data completeness. Record count measures volume and user adoption measures logins/activity, not how complete each record is.

text: It is challenging for the sales operations team to provide Universal Containers with accurate and insightful reports due to the poor quality and high volume of Account, Contact, and Lead data. As the team performs data cleansing, productivity has been impacted, leading to inefficiency and low adoption. What should the consultant do first?

options.text: Install and configure a data cleansing app from AppExchange.
Create a data management plan and a data quality dashboard.
Use Duplicate Rules to identify and report data quality issues.

explanation: Before tools or rules, the team needs a data management plan (ownership, standards, cleansing process) and a data quality dashboard to measure progress. Duplicate rules and cleansing apps are tactics that should follow the plan.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) wants to implement sharing rules. Which consideration should the consultant explain to CK?

options.text: Sharing rules can expand access beyond the organization-wide default levels.
When a sharing rule is deleted, the sharing access created by that rule must be manually removed.
Sharing rules apply only to new records that meet the definition of the source data set.

explanation: Sharing rules only open access wider than the organization-wide default; they can never restrict below it. Deleting a rule automatically removes the access it granted, and rules apply to all matching records, not just new ones.

text: During the Deploy phase at Cloud Kicks, users are finding it difficult to navigate a new system which is contributing to low adoption. How should the consultant avoid this issue in the future?

options.text: Develop test scripts during the Plan phase.
Provide company-wide training throughout the project.
Conduct a beta review during the Validate phase.

explanation: Low adoption from users struggling to navigate is a training and change-management gap, so training should run throughout the project rather than only at deployment. Test scripts and beta reviews validate the build, not user readiness.

text: Cloud Kicks' (CK) VP of technology wants to start using Sales Cloud for all of the sales team's automation. CK migrated 70 million records from a legacy database to the data warehouse that will be synced with Sales Cloud. CK wants to search and cross-reference records with the original source database. What should a consultant recommend to meet this requirement?

options.text: Use the standard External ID field and map this to the source record ID value.
Use a custom field named External ID and map this to the Sales Cloud record value.
Use a custom External ID field and map this to the source record ID value.

explanation: A custom External ID field holding the source system's record ID gives a unique, indexed key for upserts and cross-referencing back to the warehouse. There is no standard External ID field, and mapping it to the Salesforce ID (Option B) defeats the purpose.

text: Northern Trail Outfitters launched Salesforce for its EMEA subsidiary 3 months ago and wants to gain insight into usage. Which option should a consultant recommend to meet this requirement?

options.text: Create and subscribe to a custom report of active users by role.
Install the Salesforce Adoption Dashboard from AppExchange.
Analyze the Setup Audit Trail to determine the number of logins per day.

explanation: The Salesforce Adoption Dashboards package from AppExchange provides ready-made login, activity, and usage dashboards for tracking adoption after a rollout. Audit trail and simple user reports don't show usage trends.

text: Universal Containers (UC) deployed Sales Cloud 3 months ago to the North American sales teams. One of the reasons UC selected Sales Cloud is its mobile support which provides flexibility for sales reps. How should the consultant assure UC's management that Sales Cloud is being successfully adopted on mobile devices?

options.text: Report on the opportunity records created on a mobile device.
Download the Login History report and filter by device type.
Review the user profiles for mobile device permissions.

explanation: Reporting on records created from the Salesforce mobile app (using the Created By Device/mobile-sourced data) shows reps are actually working in the mobile app. Login History by device shows access, not usage; profile permissions show nothing about adoption.

text: An executive at Cloud Kicks (CK) has asked its admin to create a diagram showing the high-level processes within the business. CK plans to use the diagram to show the context of a new process within the overall business. What should the admin create to meet this requirement?

options.text: Capability Model
Value Stream Map
Detail Process Mapping

explanation: A Capability Model shows the high-level business capabilities and how they relate, which is exactly the context view an executive wants for positioning a new process. A Value Stream Map or detailed process map is far more granular.

text: Cloud Kicks uses an external Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) application to process its orders. The ERP application needs to receive data about opportunities when the opportunity closes. Which solution should the consultant recommend?

options.text: External Relationship with custom object
Salesforce Connect
Outbound Message with record-triggered flow

explanation: An outbound message sent from a record-triggered flow when the opportunity closes pushes the opportunity data to the ERP endpoint with no code. Salesforce Connect and external relationships read external data; they don't push updates out.

text: Cloud Kicks needs to implement a group of campaigns that are related to a specific marketing initiative to report on success. What should a consultant recommend to meet the requirement?

options.text: Create a custom Campaign Purpose field.
Use the existing Parent Campaign field.
Create a custom Campaign Group object.

explanation: The standard Parent Campaign field groups related campaigns into a hierarchy, and campaign hierarchy reports roll up results for the whole initiative. A custom field or object duplicates built-in functionality.

text: During the last requirements meeting, Cloud Kicks team members said they will be attending a conference next week. What should a consultant do in response to this news?

options.text: Use the downtime to develop User Acceptance Testing (UAT) scripts.
Update the project plan and communicate it to stakeholders.
Ask the client to sign off on requirements and start the Build phase.

explanation: A week of stakeholder unavailability affects the schedule, so the consultant updates the project plan and communicates the impact to stakeholders. Starting the Build phase or writing UAT scripts without sign-off skips process steps.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) recently completed the first phase of its Sales Cloud implementation. in the next phase, one factor that consultants are considering is whether any of CK's 500 sales agents are using a mobile device or a browser to access Salesforce. What should the consultants do to efficiently analyze how users are logging in to Salesforce?

options.text: Create a custom report on the User object.
Review the login history on the user record.
Create a User report and filter by Login Subtype.

explanation: The Login Subtype on user login history distinguishes the Salesforce mobile app from browser logins, so a User report filtered by Login Subtype gives the answer across all 500 users at once. Checking each user record individually doesn't scale.

text: Cloud Kicks wants to streamline the approval process and give sales managers more efficient ways to approve opportunities in a timely manner. Which strategy should the consultant recommend to improve Approval Processes?

options.text: Allow managers to approve or reject requests via an email.
Configure Einstein Opportunity Insights to approve requests.
Add a dashboard of pending approvals to the Chatter feed.

explanation: Enabling email approval response lets managers approve or reject requests by replying to the notification email — no login required. Einstein Opportunity Insights doesn't approve records, and a Chatter dashboard still requires navigating to approve.

text: How can a consultant determine which capabilities of a Sales Cloud implementation are required during the Discovery phase?

options.text: Demo Sales Cloud to end users.
Establish KPIs for end users.
Observe end users.

explanation: Observing end users during Discovery reveals how work is actually done and which capabilities are truly required. Demos show features rather than needs, and KPIs measure outcomes after the fact.

text: Cloud Kicks acquired a company. The VP of technology wants to migrate all the sales data into Sales Cloud. Which data migration sequence should the consultant recommend for the objects?

options.text: Opportunities, Products, Product Line items, Cases, Leads, Campaigns, Accounts, Contacts
Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Products, Product Line items, Cases, Leads, Campaigns
Accounts, Opportunities, Contacts, Products, Product Line items, Cases, Leads, Campaigns

explanation: Parent records must exist before their children: Accounts, then Contacts, then Opportunities, then Products and Opportunity Line Items, followed by Cases, Leads, and Campaigns. Loading opportunities before accounts (Option A) or contacts after opportunities (Option C) breaks the lookups.

text: The consultant at Cloud Kicks has successfully implemented Einstein Lead Scoring. The VP of sales wants to see the effectiveness of this new functionality. What should the consultant do to fulfill this request?

options.text: Create a custom report type for Sales Cloud Einstein records.
Add the Einstein prediction column to the forecast list view.
Add a standard dashboard for Sales Cloud Einstein.

explanation: Sales Cloud Einstein ships standard dashboards that show how lead scores correlate with conversion, which is the quickest way to demonstrate Einstein Lead Scoring's effectiveness. Custom report types and forecast list columns don't provide that analysis.

text: A consultant is initiating a Sales Cloud project for Cloud Kicks. Which essential action should the consultant prioritize to ensure successful implementation and adoption?

options.text: Design end user training plan.
Set project milestones and establish key performance indicators (KPIs).
Develop Quality Assurance (QA) testing scripts.

explanation: Setting milestones and KPIs at project start gives every later decision a measurable target and lets the team prove adoption. Training plans and QA scripts are important but come after the project's success criteria are defined.

text: Sales reps at Cloud Kicks are responsible for creating leads manually and uploading leads. The marketing department has noticed that some leads are missing important information. Which functionality should the consultant apply to ensure that the main fields are populated?

options.text: Path with key fields
Required fields
Screen flows

explanation: Making the key fields Required (universally required or on the layout) guarantees they are populated whether leads are created manually or uploaded. Path key fields are only guidance, and a screen flow doesn't apply to uploads.

text: A consultant is addressing Cloud Kicks' performance measurement needs and overcoming challenges within Sales Cloud. Which approach should a consultant adopt?

options.text: Collaborate closely with the customer to discern their specific performance measurement requirements.
Implement standardized performance measurement practices to ensure consistency across Sales Cloud.
Rely on general industry standards to determine performance measurement criteria and system architecture.

explanation: Performance measurement should reflect the customer's own goals, so the consultant works closely with the customer to define their specific requirements. Generic standards or one-size-fits-all practices miss what the business actually needs to measure.

text: Universal Containers is analyzing data to identify gaps, and wants to know which Accounts with open Opportunities are missing Contacts. What should a consultant recommend to build this report?

options.text: Reporting snapshot
Roll-up summary field
Cross filter

explanation: A cross filter with a 'without' condition (Accounts with Opportunities, without Contacts) answers the question directly in a standard report. Reporting snapshots and roll-up fields don't identify missing related records.

text: Universal Containers (UC) does business with a contact associated with a specific account with the contact role of executive. The contact is also on the board of a nonprofit that has requested a charitable donation from UC. UC wants to track the contact on both accounts. What is the most efficient solution that the consultant should implement to meet the requirement?

options.text: Create a new lookup field on the Contact record.
Create a new Contact record related to the nonprofit account.
Enable the Contact to Multiple Accounts feature.

explanation: Contacts to Multiple Accounts lets one contact be related to several accounts with a role on each, so the executive can be tracked on both the customer account and the nonprofit without a duplicate record or custom lookup.

text: Cloud Kicks wants to improve its return on investment (ROI) by creating intelligent processes built on trusted, targeted data. What is a justification for using AppExchange data services?

options.text: To use Salesforce Surveys to update customers' data
To create customer segments with personas and scoring
To activate customizable sales forecasting and lead scoring

explanation: AppExchange data services enrich records with trusted third-party data, which lets the company build segments with personas and scoring for targeted, intelligent processes. Surveys and forecasting features aren't data services.

text: Cloud Kicks wants to enable sales reps to view an individual team member's split percentage when the split percentage is less than 100% of the revenue amount. Which attribution method should the consultant recommend?

options.text: Opportunity Percentage Split
Opportunity Amount Split
Opportunity Overlay Split

explanation: Overlay splits credit supporting team members without having to total 100%, so a member's share can be less than 100% of the revenue amount. Revenue (percentage/amount) splits must always add up to 100% of the opportunity.

text: Cloud Kicks has configured Account Teams and is ready to live in production. How should the consultant migrate the Account Team Members records to production?

options.text: Distribute them with packages.
Migrate them via Data Loader,
Deploy them with change sets.

explanation: Account Team Member records are data, not metadata, so they are loaded into production with Data Loader. Change sets and packages move configuration only.

text: Sales managers at Cloud Kicks need to visualize all open opportunities within a 10-mile radius based on the location of the related account. Which solution should a consultant recommend?

options.text: Leverage Salesforce Maps to show open opportunities on a Data Layer.
Create a dashboard that uses a report grouping opportunities by account location.
Enable Location Services and add the Account Address field to the Opportunity page layout.

explanation: Salesforce Maps plots accounts and their open opportunities on a map data layer and supports radius-based views, which answers the 10-mile-radius requirement out of the box. A grouped report or an address field on the layout can't visualize distance.

text: A consultant received feedback that various sales teams are providing inconsistent updates to leadership about the progress of deals. What should the consultant recommend for aligning processes and providing more reliable information about the pipeline to leadership?

options.text: Create a Sales Engagement report.
Customize Sales Path.
Enable Sales Forecasting.

explanation: Collaborative Forecasting gives leadership a single, structured view of the pipeline by forecast category with roll-ups by manager, replacing ad-hoc updates with consistent numbers. Sales Path guides reps through stages, and a Sales Engagement report tracks outreach, not pipeline commitments.

text: Sales reps at Cloud Kicks (CK) often receive important customer emails they want to log as records related to Contacts in Salesforce. CK has Office 365, as well as a policy that prevents users from installing anything directly on their computers. Which solution should a consultant recommend to meet this requirement?

options.text: Einstein Activity Capture
Salesforce Inbox
Lightning Console for Sales

explanation: Einstein Activity Capture connects to Office 365 in the cloud and automatically logs emails to related contacts, with nothing installed on user machines. Salesforce Inbox requires a client install/extension, and the console doesn't capture email.

text: The Discovery phase with Cloud Kicks (CK) has just ended. CK wants a visual way to see how the new business processes will work. CK's process is complex and requires multiple slides. What should the consultant create to provide this high-level view?

options.text: Value Stream Map
Universal Process Notation
Capability Model

explanation: Universal Process Notation (UPN) is Salesforce's recommended way to diagram business processes: a high-level view that drills down into detail across multiple levels, ideal for a complex process that spans several slides. Capability models and value stream maps don't show process flow.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) plans to implement Advanced Currency Management in Sales Cloud. CK has roll-up summary fields on the Opportunity. What should CK consider when enabling Advanced Currency Management in its Sales Cloud org?

options.text: Opportunity roll-up summary fields will update from the Opportunity Line Item object.
Opportunity cross-object formulas always use the dynamic conversion rate for currency conversion.
Dated exchange rates are used in Opportunity forecasting or currency fields in other types of reports.

explanation: With Advanced Currency Management, roll-up summary fields are supported only from Opportunity Line Items to the Opportunity because both share the same currency and close date; roll-ups from Opportunity to Account aren't allowed. Dated exchange rates don't apply to forecasting or other report types, and cross-object formulas don't use dated rates.

text: The sales director at Universal Containers wants to ensure that a custom field on the Lead object is excluded from Einstein Lead Scoring. How should the consultant meet the requirement?

options.text: Clear the custom field values on Lead records.
Omit the custom field from the Scoring Model.
Remove the custom field from Lead page layouts.

explanation: Einstein Lead Scoring lets the admin choose which Lead fields the model considers; omitting the custom field from the scoring model excludes it. Clearing values or hiding the field from layouts doesn't affect the model.

text: Sales stages are shared between sales methodologies at Cloud Kicks. There are three product lines with unique sales methodologies. A few sales stages overlap between the three product lines. What should the consultant do?

options.text: Create three account teams.
Create three opportunity stages.
Create three sales processes.

explanation: Each product line gets its own Sales Process containing only the stages that apply to it, and shared stages can appear in more than one process. Stages are defined once (not three times), and account teams have nothing to do with methodology.

text: During the requirements gathering workshops at Cloud Kicks, the project team and subject matter experts bring up new ideas to incorporate into the current project. Which best practice should the consultant use to refocus the meeting and stay on topic?

options.text: Remind the team of the purpose and scope of this project.
Incorporate the new ideas into the solution design.
Invite only the subject matter experts to subsequent workshops.

explanation: When new ideas surface mid-workshop, the consultant should restate the project's purpose and scope and park the ideas for a later phase or change request. Absorbing them into the design creates scope creep, and excluding participants loses valuable input.

text: The Cloud Kicks global sales team has asked for a simpler way to view and manage its opportunity pipeline. The team is often responsible for hundreds of deals at a time across multiple countries and currencies. The sales reps have suggested using the Kanban view. What is a consideration when using the Kanban view?

options.text: It can display up to 10 fields per card.
It can summarize records by Currency fields.
It can show roll-up summary fields for Currency fields.

explanation: Kanban view can summarize each column by a numeric or currency field (for example total Amount), but it can't summarize roll-up summary fields and shows only a handful of fields per card. Option B is the true statement.

text: Sales managers at Cloud Kicks need to show reports and dashboards with Opportunity Forecast by Product family with team Quotas. Which solution should a consultant recommend?

options.text: Configure Quotas with a Product family report and add necessary fields.
Create a joined report with closed Opportunities, Forecasting items, and Quotas.
Create a custom report type with Forecasting Quotas and Forecasting items.

explanation: A custom report type joining Forecasting Quotas with Forecasting Items lets managers report actual forecast amounts by product family against team quotas. Quotas aren't configured through reports, and a joined report on closed opportunities lacks forecast items.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) is starting to plan its first Salesforce Release. CK would like to put together a comprehensive preview of the release to communicate the upcoming changes and new features to the leadership team, stakeholders, and end users. CK has asked a consultant for guidance. Which option should the consultant recommend?

options.text: Release in a Box
Release Matrix
Release Notes

explanation: Release in a Box is Salesforce's kit for communicating an upcoming release internally: a customizable deck and materials that summarize new features and changes for stakeholders and end users. Release notes are the raw source, and Release Matrix is not a Salesforce resource.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) is adding hundreds of new accounts to Sales Cloud daily. CK uses an automated process to assign Account owners. If no assignment can be made for an account, it will be routed to a specific user who will manually review and re-assign it at a later date. This user may have thousands of account records assigned. Which solution should the consultant recommend when CK sets up the new account process?

options.text: Place the user in a separate role at the highest level of the role hierarchy.
Assign the Modify All Data permission to the user.
Add the user to a separate role at the lowest level of the role hierarchy.

explanation: A user who owns thousands of accounts should sit in a role at the bottom of the hierarchy so their records don't roll up to and inflate sharing for every role above them, which reduces sharing recalculation load. Placing them at the top or granting Modify All Data creates the opposite problem.

text: Universal Containers has hired a new employee for the global sales leadership team. The employee is interested in fostering friendly competition between account executives, with an emphasis on reinforcing activities that drive sales. Which action should help support the sales teams?

options.text: Create a dashboard that displays the most sales closed by region using charts to show sales in green and lost opportunities in red.
Show a leaderboard on the regional sales dashboards highlighting the account executives who have created the most opportunities.
Show a leaderboard on the regional sales dashboards highlighting account executives who have held the most prospect meetings.

explanation: The goal is to reinforce the activities that drive sales, so the leaderboard should rank reps on the sales activity itself — prospect meetings held. Counting opportunities created rewards pipeline entry rather than the behavior being encouraged.

text: The sales director at Cloud Kicks wants to enable Person Accounts in its org. The sales director asked a consultant to evaluate the solution and present it to the sales team. What should the consultant consider when evaluating Person Accounts?

options.text: Enabling Person Accounts requires a Public Read/Write sharing model,
Enabling Person Accounts is irreversible.
Person Accounts must have at least two record types.

explanation: Once Person Accounts are enabled they can't be turned off, so the decision must be evaluated carefully. They don't require a Public Read/Write model, and only one Person Account record type is needed.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) acquired a shoe distribution partner. The marketing and sales directors want to migrate the existing sales and marketing data into CK's Sales Cloud instance. Which aspect should the consultant consider first before proceeding with the data migration?

options.text: Number of marketing campaign licenses required for the migration
Role hierarchy and sharing rules set up prior to migration
Volume of customer, partner, and prospect data identified prior to migration

explanation: Data volume is the first consideration: the amount of customer, partner, and prospect data determines the migration approach, tooling, and timeline. Sharing setup and license counts come after the scope of data is understood.

text: Cloud Kicks wants to implement a methodology to determine which current leads have the most in common with leads that have successfully been converted in the past. How should the consultant meet this requirement?

options.text: Use Lead Conversion Reporting.
Use Einstein Lead Scoring.
Create Cadence Steps.

explanation: Einstein Lead Scoring analyzes historical converted leads and scores current leads by how closely they resemble past conversions — exactly the requested methodology. Conversion reporting is descriptive only, and cadences are outreach steps.

text: The sales team at Cloud Kicks has been late meeting project deadlines and missed multiple meetings. What should the consultant recommend to the project manager?

options.text: Bring additional resources from the consulting firm to the project.
Confirm that the statement of work (SOW) is realistic.
Revisit the communication plan and set up more frequent check-ins.

explanation: Missed deadlines and meetings point to a communication breakdown, so the consultant recommends revisiting the communication plan and adding more frequent check-ins. Adding consultants or re-validating the SOW doesn't fix client engagement.

text: It is a priority at Cloud Kicks to implement logic and automation to qualify top leads. The company has captured significant data points on converted leads and won opportunities. What should the consultant do first to ensure a best practices implementation?

options.text: Identify a recommended base Lead score, evaluate the results, and adjust the score accordingly.
Review converted lead data with sales and marketing to understand the interaction patterns that led to conversion.
Configure a qualification screen flow to help sales reps quickly determine which leads are most important.

explanation: A best-practice scoring implementation starts by analyzing the converted-lead and won-opportunity data with sales and marketing to identify which interactions predict conversion; the scoring logic is built from those findings. Picking a base score or building a flow first puts the solution before the analysis.

text: A custom lead qualification process was implemented at Universal Containers over a year ago. The process has been underutilized by sales reps. A consultant suggested that the reason why adoption of the process by sales reps is poor is due to a lack of executive sponsorship. Why is executive sponsor involvement so important for success?

options.text: Executive sponsors support the system after launch.
Executive sponsors are champions of the project.
Executive sponsors ensure there is a workable solution.

explanation: Executive sponsors act as champions who visibly back the project, communicate its importance, and hold teams accountable for adopting it. Without that sponsorship a process is easily ignored, regardless of how well it was built.

text: Sometimes, Universal Containers sales reps need to create contacts without accounts based on business processes. What should the consultant take into consideration?

options.text: Contacts are private and shared through sharing rules.
Contacts are private and shared through the role hierarchy.
Contacts are private and only the owner and admin can view them.

explanation: A contact with no account is a private contact: it's visible only to its owner and to administrators, and it isn't shared through the role hierarchy or sharing rules. Business processes that create such contacts should account for that limited visibility.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) frequently works with contractors for marketing focus groups. These contractors change companies often, and CK wants to retain its company history through Accounts. What should the consultant recommend?

options.text: Use a custom object to represent the previous companies.
Implement the Contacts to Multiple Accounts feature.
Implement Person Accounts to represent the relationship.

explanation: Contacts to Multiple Accounts keeps one contact record and relates it to each company the contractor works for over time, preserving the account-level history as the person moves. Person Accounts model individuals as accounts and don't solve the many-company history problem.

text: Cloud Kicks wants to send an email notification to the VP of sales whenever any opportunity with an amount of $100,000 or more reaches a probability of 75% or more. Which solution should the consultant recommend?

options.text: Configure a flow with an email alert for the opportunity.
Change the stage on the opportunity.
Create a Lightning Email Template for the opportunity.

explanation: A record-triggered flow on Opportunity with entry criteria Amount ≥ 100,000 and Probability ≥ 75% can send an Email Alert to the VP. Changing stages or creating an email template alone doesn't trigger a notification.

text: Universal Containers (UC) has acquired another company that uses Sales Cloud and is migrating its legacy data, email alerts, and approval processes. Which steps should the consultant perform to maintain data integrity?

options.text: Use the Sales Cloud clone feature to migrate email alerts and approval processes into UC's Sales Cloud org.
Merge data from the existing Sales Cloud org into UC's Sales Cloud org, migrate email alerts, approval processes, and then users.
Insert users and migrate email alerts and approval processes into UC's Sales Cloud org.

explanation: Users must exist in the target org first so that migrated records can be assigned to their owners; then email alerts and approval processes (metadata) are deployed. There is no cross-org clone feature, and loading data before users breaks ownership.

text: Cloud Kicks has a Public Read Only Opportunity sharing model. A sales rep noticed they can edit some opportunities associated with accounts they own, but are unable to edit other opportunities associated with accounts they own. Which reason explains the sales rep's experience?

options.text: Some opportunities associated with these accounts are owned by other users.
Sharing rules for Opportunities are set to a public group for managers.
The user is a member of an Account Team with Read/Write access on Opportunities.

explanation: Under a Public Read-Only model a rep can edit opportunities they own but only read opportunities owned by others — owning the account doesn't grant edit rights on its opportunities. So the editable opportunities are the ones the rep owns, and the rest belong to other users.

text: Cloud Kicks has a large remote sales department working in many different locations. Management wants greater visibility into the opportunities in progress with their respective teams. They also want to receive emails when opportunities reach key metrics (for example, stage progression) or a high probability. However, they want to control the frequency of their emails. Which solution should a consultant recommend?

options.text: Subscribe to Chatter Feed Tracking to receive updates.
Define a record-triggered flow when the stage is updated to new values.
Create a report filtering for the criteria and allow managers to subscribe to the report.

explanation: A report filtered on the key metrics (stage, probability) that managers subscribe to lets each manager choose their own delivery frequency. A record-triggered flow emails on every change with no per-manager control, and Chatter feed tracking is noisy.

text: During a discovery session at Cloud Kicks, a major topic is highlighted that is outside the current statement of work (SOW). The addition to the project scope is necessary but will be difficult to implement. How should the consultant proceed?

options.text: Create a change request for the new items.
Revise the timeline to accommodate the new items.
Conduct another discovery session to define the new items.

explanation: Work outside the SOW is handled through a formal change request that documents the new scope, effort, and impact for approval. Quietly extending the timeline or running more discovery bypasses the change-control process.

text: Northern Trail Outfitters has created a Complaints custom object related to Accounts. The organization-wide default has been set to Private. Only users within the Complaints Specialist public group should be able to view and edit any Complaint record. Which option should a consultant recommend to meet the requirements?

options.text: Use Apex managed sharing to grant record access to users in the Complaints Specialist public group.
Create a criteria-based sharing rule that grants Read/Write access to the Complaints Specialist public group.
Set the Complaints object's default visibility to allow only the users in the Complaints Specialist public group to access the records.

explanation: With OWD Private, a criteria-based (or owner-based) sharing rule that grants Read/Write to the Complaints Specialist public group opens all Complaint records to exactly those users. There is no object-level visibility setting for a group, and Apex managed sharing is unnecessary when a declarative rule fits.

text: The sales team at Cloud Kicks needs to track the number of retail locations for each of its leads. Once the lead is converted, the sales team wants to see the number of retail locations related to their customers. The service team also wants to view this information. What should the consultant do to meet this requirement?

options.text: Create a custom object related to the Account and Lead objects to store the retail locations.
Map the custom field from the Lead object to the custom field on the Account object during lead conversion.
Add roll-up summary fields to calculate the number of retail locations related to the Account and Lead objects.

explanation: Lead field mapping lets a custom Lead field (retail locations) be mapped to a custom Account field so the value carries over on conversion, where both sales and service can see it on the Account. A custom object or roll-up summary adds complexity without solving the handoff.

text: The Cloud Kicks sales team can create leads for both business and individual customers. Person Accounts have been enabled in its Salesforce org. What should the consultant do to convert a Lead into a Person Account?

options.text: Enable Contact Roles.
Leave the Company field blank.
Create an Apex trigger on the Lead object.

explanation: When Person Accounts are enabled, a lead converts into a Person Account when the Company field is blank; a populated Company converts into a business account and contact. No trigger or contact roles are required.

text: Cloud Kicks currently supports three business lines within a single Salesforce instance: Running, Athleisure, and Celebrity Co-Branded. The VP of Athleisure controls a large budget and is often able to re-prioritize business stories and 'shadow projects' into releases ahead of other groups. This topic comes up frequently and often derails the monthly project management meeting. This limits the amount of time available to cover other critical topics. Which strategy should the consultant recommend to address these issues?

options.text: Create a weekly all-hands call, including business and technology resources, to review direction and priority of development.
Propose a monthly executive steering committee to manage budget, handle direction questions, and ensure development capacity is split equitably.
Divide the development team into three units/tracks to support each line of business Independently.

explanation: A monthly executive steering committee provides the governance body to manage budget, resolve direction and priority conflicts, and split development capacity equitably across the business lines — taking those debates out of the project meeting. Weekly all-hands calls don't decide priority, and splitting the team fragments the platform.

text: The Cloud Kicks IT team has noticed that there are many duplicate Person Accounts and wants to merge them. What should the consultant explain to the team about merging Person Accounts?

options.text: They can be merged with contact records.
They can be merged with any type of Account.
They can be merged with other Person Accounts.

explanation: Person Accounts can only be merged with other Person Accounts; they can't be merged with business accounts or with contact records.

text: The sales director at Universal Containers is concerned the percentage of all opportunities marked Closed Won is lower than expected. Historically, qualified leads must have a budget that is at least $10,000. The director wants sales reps to prioritize high-value prospects. Which action should a consultant recommend to meet the requirement?

options.text: Use an approval process upon lead conversion when the budget is over $10,000.
Map the Lead Budget field to an Opportunity Revenue field.
Map the Lead Budget field to an Opportunity Amount field on the Opportunity.

explanation: Mapping the Lead Budget field to the Opportunity Amount on conversion carries the qualification value into the pipeline, letting reps sort and prioritize high-value opportunities immediately. An approval process adds friction, and there is no standard Opportunity Revenue field.

text: Cloud Kicks wants to measure the adoption of its Sales Cloud rollout. Which key performance indicator (KPI) should the consultant recommend?

options.text: Number of Opportunities Closed Lost in the last month
Number of User logins in the last month
Number of Community Contacts added in the last year

explanation: Adoption is measured by usage, and the number of user logins in the last month is the standard first-level adoption KPI. Closed Lost counts measure sales outcomes, and Community contacts are unrelated.

text: Cloud Kicks has 300,000 account records and 16 million invoices in a custom object with a master-detail relationship to the Account. End users have stated that each account record takes a long time to display. What should the consultant do to reduce the amount of time it takes to load pages and increase adoption?

options.text: Convert the Invoice master-detail into a lookup relationship and tell the users it is a required field.
Move the invoice related list to a separate tab on the record page and communicate the change to users.
Enable indexing on all visible fields on the Invoice related list and create a training plan for the users.

explanation: A related list with millions of child rows slows the record page as it renders; moving the Invoice related list to its own tab defers that load until users need it. Changing the relationship type or indexing fields doesn't reduce what the page renders.

text: Universal Containers (UC) has Account and Contact data it wants to migrate to Sales Cloud. The data comes from several sources and the data quality is unknown. The consultant wants to assess the entire data set for quality prior to loading it to production without impacting UC's current operations. The consultant recommends using a Full Copy sandbox as an initial step. Which Sales Cloud feature should the consultant use to support this approach?

options.text: Import Wizard
Duplicate Jobs
External IDs

explanation: Duplicate Jobs (with matching rules) scan an entire object in bulk and report duplicate sets, which lets the consultant assess data quality in a Full Copy sandbox before loading production. Import Wizard and External IDs load data; they don't assess it.

text: Cloud Kicks want to track the return on investment (ROI) of its marketing campaigns for trade shows and customer webinars. What should the consultant recommend?

options.text: Use the Primary Campaign Source field on the Opportunity object.
Enable Campaign Influence and add It to the Opportunity page layout.
Create a custom field on the Opportunity object to capture Campaign details.

explanation: Primary Campaign Source links each opportunity to the campaign that generated it, so standard campaign statistics and the Campaign ROI Analysis report show revenue won against campaign cost for the trade shows and webinars. Campaign Influence is for multi-touch attribution, and a custom field would bypass campaign reporting.

text: Cloud Kicks has just deployed all of its configurations. The admin wants to build a new process using objects that were deployed. Which best practice should a consultant recommend to the admin?

options.text: Build in a Partial Copy sandbox and test changes in the staging environment.
Build in a test release environment end test changes In a Partial Copy sandbox.
Build in a Developer sandbox and test changes in a test release environment.

explanation: Salesforce's ALM best practice is to build in a Developer sandbox and then promote changes to a testing/staging environment (for example a Partial or Full Copy sandbox) for validation before production. Building directly in a Partial Copy sandbox mixes development with testing.

text: Cloud Kicks needs to set sales quotas for all sales reps. Which solution should the consultant consider?

options.text: Use the Data Import Wizard.
Enable Forecast Quotas from Setup.
Assign quota values by profile.

explanation: Quotas are part of Collaborative Forecasts and are turned on under Forecast Settings (Show Quotas / Enable Forecast Quotas); values can then be loaded with Data Loader or the Quotas setup page. Quotas aren't assigned by profile, and the Import Wizard doesn't load them.

text: Universal Containers (UC) recently implemented new Sales Cloud solutions. UC stakeholders believe that user adoption is best measured by the login rate. Which additional key metric should the consultant recommend?

options.text: Opportunities created in the last 30 days
Events synchronized in the last 30 days
Cases closed in the last 30 days

explanation: Logins show that users open Salesforce; opportunities created in the last 30 days shows they are actually working their pipeline in it, which is the meaningful adoption signal for a sales rollout. Event sync and closed cases don't measure Sales Cloud usage.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) recently finished a redeployment of its Lightning pages. CK users report that Lightning pages are loading slowly. CK management wants to consider the impact this has on adoption. What should the consultant recommend that CK use to evaluate Lightning pages?

options.text: Data Integration Metric
Performance Analysis for App Builder
Real-Time Event Monitoring

explanation: Performance Analysis for App Builder analyzes a Lightning record page and reports which components and fields slow it down, with recommendations to fix them. Event Monitoring and data integration metrics don't diagnose page performance.

text: Management at Universal Containers wants to identify duplicate Leads in its org so marketing reps can clean them up later. What should a consultant do to ensure clean leads for the marketing reps?

options.text: Create a formula field on Lead for duplicates.
Create a Validation Rule to find duplicates.
Run a duplicate job with a Matching Rule.

explanation: A duplicate job runs a matching rule across all existing Lead records and produces duplicate record sets that marketing can review and merge later. Formula fields and validation rules only operate on one record at a time.

text: The Northern Trail Outfitters sales team has reported that many of the leads they receive are missing an email address or phone number. Which approach should a consultant recommend to address this issue?

options.text: Set default values for Phone and Email fields on the Lead object.
Make Phone and Email fields required on the Lead convert form.
Create a validation rule that requires a Phone and Email.

explanation: A validation rule that requires Phone and Email enforces the data at save time for every lead regardless of how it's created. Default values would insert placeholder data, and the convert form is too late in the process.

text: Universal Containers (UC) is going to kick off a Sales Cloud implementation project next month. in preparation for discovery workshops with the business stakeholders, the project manager has asked for a list of key topics the team wants to ask the client about prior to the workshop. Which topics will help the team get to know UC better?

options.text: Goals, values, Initiatives, strategies, and obstacles
Specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound
Budget, authority, need, and time

explanation: Understanding a client starts with their Goals, Values, Initiatives, Strategies, and Obstacles (GVISO) — the framing Salesforce recommends for discovery preparation. SMART describes how to write goals, and BANT is a lead-qualification framework.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) has hired a consultant to help enhance its current Salesforce implementation. What should the consultant do first to help CK meet its business requirements?

options.text: Conduct discovery sessions.
Design the architecture.
Define the solution.

explanation: Enhancing an existing implementation still starts with discovery sessions to understand current pain points and business requirements. Designing architecture or defining a solution before discovery risks solving the wrong problem.

text: Universal Containers has a large amount of data that currently lives in a system outside of Sales Cloud. Users need to see a subset of this data. Which consideration should the consultant take into account?

options.text: Salesforce Connect External Objects count against the limit of custom objects.
Salesforce Connect should be used with on-premises data systems.
Salesforce Connect allows real-time access to current data.

explanation: Salesforce Connect maps external data to external objects that are read in real time, so users always see current data without storing it in Salesforce. External objects have their own limit (they don't consume custom object allocations), and Connect works with cloud or on-premises sources.

text: A consultant for Universal Containers is preparing to migrate the company's legacy CRM to Sales Cloud. The admin for the previous system is enthusiastic about Sales Cloud and driving the objectives of the implementation, but end users have expressed dissatisfaction about moving to a new platform. How should the consultant determine and validate their approach with end users?

options.text: Enlist the help of a champion to ensure that Sales Cloud is meeting end user needs.
Interview top-level executives to understand the Sales Cloud key performance indicators (KPIs) for end users.
Conduct a technical review of Sales Cloud with developers to evaluate solutions for end users.

explanation: Dissatisfied end users are best reached through a peer champion who represents their needs, validates the approach, and advocates for the change. Executive KPIs and developer reviews don't capture the end-user perspective.

text: Universal Containers is in the planning phase of its Sales Cloud implementation. In a recent discussion, the CEO expressed a desire to measure the return on investment (ROI) of its sales and marketing efforts by location. Which solution should the consultant recommend?

options.text: Track total opportunity pipeline by lead source and location.
Track total accounts created by lead source and location.
Track total cases submitted by lead source and location.

explanation: ROI on sales and marketing effort is measured through pipeline and revenue, so tracking total opportunity pipeline by Lead Source and location links outcomes to the channel and geography that generated them. Accounts created or cases submitted don't measure return.

text: Sales managers at Cloud Kicks want to create a sales dashboard of key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure day-to-day operations. Which key metric should the consultant include in the dashboard?

options.text: Number of outbound calls made over a period of time
Number of updated opportunities
Number of marketing qualified leads (MQL)

explanation: Day-to-day operational KPIs measure rep activity, and outbound calls over a period is a direct activity metric managers can act on daily. MQL counts are a marketing measure, and 'updated opportunities' is too vague to drive behavior.

text: Cloud Kicks' (CK) global sales operations team has to export reports from Salesforce and manipulate them in Excel to convert regional deals to the correct currency conversion. CK wants to generate accurate reporting directly in Sales Cloud. After enabling Advanced Currency Management, what should the consultant do next?

options.text: Update currency values manually on a weekly basis.
Show deal values in a user's default currency.
Adjust currency conversion dynamically based on date range.

explanation: Advanced Currency Management adds dated exchange rates, so the next step is to define rate ranges by date so opportunity amounts convert using the rate in effect on their close date. Manual weekly updates or user-currency display don't give accurate historical conversion.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) has recently rolled out Sales Cloud. CK uses an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system as its system of record for customer data. When an account has its first Closed Won opportunity, the ERP system should be updated immediately from the account and opportunity records. Which option should the consultant recommend to meet the requirement?

options.text: Script the ERP to call a Flow endpoint every 5 minutes to fetch newly won opportunities and their related accounts.
Implement Platform Events to publish Opportunity wins to the ERP, which will call back for opportunity and account information.
Create an Accounts with Opportunities report filtered on Opportunities won today that the ERP can subscribe to.

explanation: Platform Events publish a Closed Won event the ERP subscribes to in near real time, and the ERP then calls back for the account and opportunity details — an event-driven pattern with no polling. Five-minute polling isn't immediate, and reports can't be subscribed to by an external system.

text: Northern Trail Outfitters published detailed activity measures for its sales teams 6 months ago. The VP of sales has noticed that the number of sales activities reps have logged has increased to meet the new standards, but the actual number of booking activities remains low. The VP suspects that sales reps misunderstand the activity measures process. What should the consultant recommend?

options.text: Deploy Sales Engagement and use Cadences.
Train the reps on targeted interactions.
Reevaluate Opportunity stages.

explanation: Sales Engagement cadences prescribe the exact sequence and type of outreach steps, so reps follow a defined process instead of logging generic activities to hit a quota. Cadences make the intended interactions explicit and measurable, which directly addresses the misunderstanding.

text: Cloud Kicks has recently set up Sales Cloud and wants to measure the health of an account by comparing the amount of emails that are exchanged in a month. What should the consultant recommend?

options.text: Salesforce Inbox
Activity Report
Einstein Activity Capture

explanation: Einstein Activity Capture syncs email and events and feeds the Activity Metrics and account insights that show email volume exchanged with each account. Salesforce Inbox is a productivity add-on, and a standard activity report only counts manually logged emails.

text: After a project deployment, several bugs were identified by end users and prioritized by the project team. How should a consultant resolve these issues?

options.text: Build out the issue resolution release in a development sandbox.
Perform user acceptance testing (UAT) In a development sandbox.
Build out the issue resolution release in the staging environment.

explanation: Bug fixes follow the same lifecycle as any release: build the fix in a development sandbox, then promote it through testing/staging before production. UAT belongs in a staging environment, not development, and building directly in staging skips the dev step.

text: What is a consideration when enabling Multiple Currencies?

options.text: Accounts, Opportunities, Leads, Cases, and Opportunity Product Schedules support multiple currencies reporting.
When Multiple Currencies is enabled, changes to exchange rates update the converted amount on all records except closed opportunities.
If any issues arise during implementation, Multiple Currencies can be disabled.

explanation: With standard (non-dated) exchange rates, changing a rate updates the converted amounts on existing records, and Salesforce documents that closed opportunities are the exception that keep their original converted values in some contexts. Multiple Currencies can't be disabled once enabled, which rules out Option C.

text: Sales reps at Universal Containers want to know when a customer or prospect contact opens an email the reps sent so they can follow up with the contact shortly afterward. Which tool should a consultant recommend to meet the requirement?

options.text: Salesforce Inbox
Enhanced Email
Einstein Activity Capture

explanation: Salesforce Inbox includes email tracking that notifies reps when a recipient opens an email so they can follow up promptly. Enhanced Email stores emails as records and Einstein Activity Capture syncs them, but neither provides open notifications.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) is developing its organizational change management (OCM) and rollout strategy. The consultant has emphasized the value of leveraging the experiences of partners and customers within the Salesforce ecosystem. Which resource should the consultant recommend to help CK reach its goal?

options.text: End user feedback
Salesforce Premier Success
Trailblazer Community

explanation: The Trailblazer Community is where Salesforce customers and partners share rollout, change-management, and adoption experiences. Premier Success is a paid support tier, and internal feedback doesn't tap the wider ecosystem.

text: Universal Containers is growing its international business. Domestic sales reps believe that the standard price book has too many records reflecting different currencies and country-specific product variations. What should the consultant recommend to improve usability for sales reps?

options.text: Update the product naming conventions to include the currency in the product name.
Use separate product catalogs for domestic and international customers.
Use custom price books for domestic and international customers.

explanation: Custom price books scoped to domestic and international customers let reps see only the products and currencies relevant to their market while the standard price book holds the master list. Renaming products or splitting catalogs is unnecessary.

text: The sales manager at Universal Containers has noticed that sales teams are having trouble understanding who should own an Opportunity. Sales teams base their sales opportunities on assignments to specific ZIP codes. Which solution should the consultant recommend?

options.text: Sharing Rules
Sales Territories
Account Teams

explanation: Sales Territories (Enterprise Territory Management) assign accounts and their opportunities based on rules such as ZIP code, so ownership and territory access are unambiguous. Sharing rules and account teams don't define geographic ownership.

text: Cloud Kicks wants sales reps to be able to give customers access to key files without setting up an Experience Cloud site. Which Salesforce feature satisfies this requirement?

options.text: Email template
File sharing link
Chatter link

explanation: A public file sharing link lets a rep share a Salesforce file with an external customer without an Experience Cloud site or Salesforce login. Email templates and Chatter links don't give external access to files.

text: After creating a brand new sneaker Product object record for Cloud Kicks, the admin is unable to add this product to Price Books. How should the consultant resolve the issue?

options.text: Add the product to a price schedule.
Edit the sharing settings of the Product object.
Set a standard active price.

explanation: A product can only be added to custom price books after it has a standard price in the Standard Price Book. Sharing settings and price schedules aren't the cause.

text: Universal Containers (UC) sales reps want to be assigned quality leads. Which action should the consultant recommend to improve UC's process to produce higher quality leads?

options.text: Identify business metrics and factors, then use picklists and formula fields to ensure data consistency.
Create a custom field on the Lead object to generate a lead score to determine lead quality.
Analyze historical data on closed leads and conversions to improve the quality of leads.

explanation: Improving lead quality starts with analyzing historical closed leads and conversions to learn what a good lead looks like; picklists, formula fields, or a homemade score should be based on those findings, not created first.

text: Universal Containers is using Collaborative Forecasts and wants to show sales reps their individual numbers for opportunities they are predicted to win based on amounts for all forecast categories over the next quarter. What should a consultant recommend to meet this requirement?

options.text: Use a formula field based on the forecast category.
Add the Forecast Summary component to the page.
Enable Cumulative Forecast Rollups.

explanation: Cumulative Forecast Rollups show each rep a cumulative number across forecast categories (for example Best Case includes Commit and Closed), which is the 'predicted to win based on all forecast categories' view requested.
